description: Use this when the user wants discount codes for a kind of product or a shopping category rather than one named store, for example "coupon for running shoes", "promo codes for skincare", "deals on coffee" or "discount codes for pet stores". Matches store names and the products each store lists on its own site first, then other stores in the categories the product words point to (e.g. headphones -> Electronics), and returns up to 25 stores with their code, discount, how to apply it, affiliate shop link and store page. Give query, category, or both. If nothing matches, the result names a category to try. Do not use for one named store (use find_coupons) or for ranking by size of discount (use list_largest_discounts).

category.description: Optional. Restrict results to one category.

limit.description: Maximum number of stores to return (1-25).

query.description: Product type, keyword or partial store name, e.g. "running shoes", "skincare", "coffee". Optional when category is given.

name: search_stores

hint.description: What to try next when nothing or only category results matched.

matched_categories.description: Categories inferred from product words in the query (closest-category results).

shop_link.description: Affiliate link to the store (opens the store with the discount).

title: Search stores with coupon codes
